import json, random, sys
import gen, check, numpy as np
from scipy import sparse
from scipy.optimize import linprog
rng = random.Random(1)
reqs = [gen.gen_request(rng) for _ in range(40)]
req = reqs[[i for i,r in enumerate(reqs) if r["epoch"]==9707][0]]
d = check.build(req)
P=d["P"]; M=d["M"]
x=np.array([6.0, 4/3, 38/3]); a=np.array(d["a"])
p=np.maximum(x-a,0); m=np.maximum(a-x,0)
n=3*P+1; ucol=3*P
rows=[];cols=[];vals=[];b=[];r=0
for e in range(M):
    for j,path in enumerate(d["flat"]):
        if e in path:
            rows.append(r);cols.append(j);vals.append(1.0)
    rows.append(r);cols.append(ucol);vals.append(-float(d["caps"][e]))
    b.append(0.0); r+=1
for j in range(P):
    rows.append(r);cols.append(j);vals.append(1.0)
    b.append(float(d["demands"][d["owner"][j]]) if d["live"][j] else 0.0); r+=1
for j in range(P):
    rows.append(r);cols.append(j);vals.append(-1.0)
    rows.append(r);cols.append(P+j);vals.append(1.0)
    b.append(-a[j]); r+=1
    rows.append(r);cols.append(j);vals.append(1.0)
    rows.append(r);cols.append(2*P+j);vals.append(1.0)
    b.append(a[j]); r+=1
for j in range(P):
    rows.append(r);cols.append(P+j);vals.append(1.0)
    rows.append(r);cols.append(2*P+j);vals.append(1.0)
b.append(2.0*req["budget"]); r+=1
rows.append(r);cols.append(ucol);vals.append(1.0); b.append(1.0); r+=1
A=sparse.coo_matrix((vals,(rows,cols)),shape=(r,n)).tocsr()
c=np.zeros(n); c[ucol]=1.0
v=np.concatenate([x,p,m,[1/3.]])
print("viol of known point:", np.max(A.dot(v)-np.array(b)))
res=linprog(c,A_ub=A,b_ub=np.array(b),bounds=(0,None),method="highs")
print("alt:",res.status,res.fun,res.x)
PYEOF
